meta.description: The 44 closed trading ideas from the audit of 53: the kind of market, how each one ended and why, plus the sha256 fingerprints of the audit's frozen plan and its result table.

intro: Every idea the audit scored. For each of the 44 closed ones: the kind of market, the recorded verdict and the cause.

audit_note: The recorded verdict stays. Where the audit's own label differs, on 6 ideas, it sits beside it: 4 of them have no result table, and for the other 2 the luck correction does not rule out a small edge.
not_closed: At the audit's snapshot, 9 ideas were not closed. Each is listed here when it closes. One idea closed on 2026-10-24, after the audit's snapshot; the audit treats it as open.

fp.label: fingerprints
fp.frozen: I froze the audit's plan at 2026-10-17 20:36:10 UTC, before its two programs were written. Its result table was frozen at 2026-10-25 00:04:29 UTC, after the checker passed.
fp.private: Both files are private for now. If they are published, anyone can hash them and compare:
fp.expect: It must print the plan's hash above. The same command on the result table must print the second.
fp.limit: The plan's hash is also in a public registry with a Bitcoin timestamp at block 972859 (2026-10-24 02:04 UTC), so the plan existed by then. The audit's first build attempt began on 2026-10-22, so that stamp alone does not show the plan came first. The result table's hash has no stamp. It proves only that a file published later is the one this page describes.
